description.value: Black Kettle Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom that opened in January 2014 just past the rail tracks in North Vancouver, a short ride from the Spirit Trail. The brewpub pours its own lagers, IPAs, and seasonal ales alongside a full kitchen menu of smash burgers, tacos, pizza, and wings. It is pet-friendly on the patio and regularly hosts live music, making it a welcoming destination for cyclists coming off the North Shore mountains or arriving via the Seabus.
